title: Premium quick-view modal on subcategory product cards + header/footer logo update

requirements.summary: On subcategory pages, open a centered quick-view modal when a product card is clicked, without changing the URL or removing existing routes.
acceptanceCriteria: On `/products/:categorySlug/:subcategorySlug`, clicking a product card does not change the URL and does not navigate away.
A modal opens centered on top of the current page content.
All existing product cards remain visible/unchanged when the modal is closed.
No changes are made to the overall routing table in `frontend/src/App.tsx` beyond what is required for the modal behavior (i.e., routes remain present and functional).

file_operations.description: Add local state to track the selected product type and render a centered quick-view modal on subcategory pages; intercept product card clicks to open the modal instead of navigating while leaving the TanStack Router route structure intact.
Extend the product card to support a click handler and keyboard accessibility (so the card can trigger quick-view opening) without changing the card’s visual structure.
Create a dedicated quick-view modal component that can be rendered from SubcategoryPage and receives product data + open/close callbacks.

requirements.summary: Implement modal overlay, close controls, ESC/outside click close, and disable background scroll with blur/dim backdrop.
acceptanceCriteria: When the modal is open, the page behind it is visibly blurred and darkened by an overlay.
When the modal is open, the document/body does not scroll (scroll is restored when the modal closes).
Clicking the overlay (outside the modal panel) closes the modal.
Pressing ESC closes the modal.
A visible close (X) control exists in the modal’s top-right and closes the modal.

file_operations.description: Implement the backdrop overlay with semi-transparent darkening and `backdrop-filter: blur(6px)`, close behaviors (X button, overlay click, ESC key), and body scroll locking while the modal is open.
Add minimal global CSS utilities (if needed) to support reliable `backdrop-filter: blur(6px)` and modal open/close animation behavior without editing any immutable UI component files.

requirements.summary: Build the premium quick-view content layout with responsive two-column/stacked design and required content sections.
acceptanceCriteria: On >= md breakpoints, the modal presents image-left / content-right.
On small screens, the modal stacks content vertically with the image above the text content.
The modal shows: title (serif, prominent), a multi-line description, a bulleted list of features, and a “Send Inquiry” CTA button.
The modal image uses a non-stretched `object-fit` style (e.g., contain/cover as appropriate) and maintains aspect ratio.

file_operations.description: Implement the responsive modal panel layout: image-left/content-right on md+, stacked on mobile; include title (serif), 3–5 line description text, a bulleted feature list, and a “Send Inquiry” button; ensure the image preserves aspect ratio via appropriate object-fit styling.

Provide the modal with the correct product information from the current subcategory productTypes (title/description/features/image) so the quick-view content renders consistently for any card clicked.

requirements.summary: Apply exact modal styling (navy background, gold border, glow shadow) and 0.3s ease fade+scale animations; style “Send Inquiry” button to gold spec with hover effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal panel background color is `#141F33`.
Modal panel has a 1px gold-toned border and a soft glow shadow (not harsh or overly large).
Modal open transition uses fade+scale and completes in ~0.3s with ease timing; closing animates smoothly as well.
The “Send Inquiry” button uses `#C8A24D` background with dark navy text, and on hover both lifts slightly and darkens slightly.

file_operations.description: Apply the specified premium styling to the modal panel (`#141F33` background, 1px gold border, soft glow shadow) and implement the subtle fade+scale open/close animation (0.3s ease; scale 0.95→1 and opacity 0→1 on open; reverse on close).

Add/adjust shared styling helpers (if needed) so the modal animation and gold button hover effects (slight lift + slight darkening) match the requested premium feel while keeping existing global theme intact.

requirements.summary: Make the modal “Send Inquiry” button navigate to `/contact` and prefill category exactly like the existing subcategory CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Send Inquiry” in the modal navigates to `/contact`.
The navigation includes the same category prefill behavior currently used by the subcategory page’s “Send Inquiry” button.
No backend changes are required for this wiring.

file_operations.description: Wire the modal “Send Inquiry” action to reuse the same navigation/search prefill behavior as the existing subcategory page CTA (navigate to `/contact` with the same category prefill).
Invoke the provided “Send Inquiry” callback from the modal CTA button and close the modal as appropriate without changing routing structure.

requirements.summary: Replace header and footer logos with the provided PNG asset, enlarge the header logo ~2× without increasing header height, preserve aspect ratio and centering.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx` and `frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx` both reference `Screenshot_2026-02-15_at_3.36.48_AM-removebg-preview.png` (served from a static public path).
Header container height remains `h-20` (or otherwise unchanged), and nav items remain vertically centered.
Header logo appears visually ~2× larger than before without causing header growth; image remains vertically centered and not stretched.
Footer logo is updated to the same new image asset and maintains clean spacing (no distortion).

file_operations.description: Add the provided high-resolution logo image as a static public asset to be referenced by header and footer.

Update the header logo image source to the new static asset and adjust sizing so it appears ~2× larger while keeping the header container height (`h-20`) unchanged, preserving aspect ratio (object-contain), vertical centering, and surrounding spacing.
Update the footer logo image source to the same new static asset and ensure clean spacing, no distortion, and preserved aspect ratio.
